generate_report: generate HTML report from LLVM optimization record YAML files with syntax highlighting
run_opt_viewer_cli: run opt-viewer.py to convert -fsave-optimization-record YAML files into browsable HTML pages
render_source_file: render a source file with inline optimization remarks and hotness annotations
render_index_page: render an index page listing all optimization remarks sorted by hotness
map_inlining_remarks: map inlining remarks to caller source locations for inline context links
